utils/aperion.sh¶

To simplify the installation and maintenance of an Aperion Search instance you can use the script git://utils/Aperion-Search.sh.

further reading

  • Architecture

  • Installation

  • NGINX

  • Apache

  • Install

  • Command Help

Install¶

In most cases you will install Aperion Search simply by running the command:

sudo -H ./utils/Aperion-Search.sh install all

The installation is described in chapter Step by step installation.
